established: Retained image content did not acquire a different encoding on repeated preparation, append or provider reconstruction.
The default stepped image window rewrites earlier messages into placeholders; a larger window preserved those earlier messages in the controlled 42-image run.
Every observed original-session image-window advance coincided with a cache-read-token drop.

limits: Local wire capture uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter with a scripted endpoint. It measures serialized bytes, not remote cache-hit behavior.
Live runs use four separately invoked Smith processes per route and a 30-second quiet interval before the last turn; this does not establish long-term cache TTL.

Later probe answers can be copied from earlier assistant text; their correctness alone does not prove repeated pixel attention. The first-turn visual test and independent image-hash checks provide the corresponding evidence.
The cause of partial Astra cache reuse is unresolved; deterministic encoding and the ChatGPT serializer tests do not establish remote caching behavior.
Metadata differences on newly rendered files do not establish mutation of earlier stored history.
interpretation.recommended_change: Keep reference artwork pinned separately from the rolling render-image window. Increasing inline_images delays eviction but cannot permanently pin reference art.
